evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!D41 requires an observed spread across partial-quality apps; the frozen skill's quality-checks.md:165-166 says a gate or common precondition must not collapse that signal. Static design has two binary gates (authored JS computation in tests/gates/render/judge.toml:18 and server-backed clean-context Save/read in tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:18), then 82 weighted Functional binary criteria, six weighted Polish binary criteria and six Visual Likert criteria (evidence/40/probe-results.json). tests/scoring.toml:2-11 sets 0.6/0.2/0.2 shares and a Functional floor of 0.05; tests/tools/score.py:41-48 computes a graded weighted result above that floor. Calling that exact frozen scorer with synthetic dimension inputs produced 0.0000 for a gates-only app, 0.2351 for five selected Functional outcomes, 0.2683 for six, and 1.0000 for all dimensions. This proves arithmetic capacity only, not actual RewardKit discrimination. The plausible weak app that only supplies a canned preview and browser-local saves should fail the authored-computation and independent-context gates; a conforming server-rendered library without a JSON endpoint should be allowed by the gate text. Whether the configured judge distinguishes either case remains untested. The current raw-evidence-index.json:92 explicitly says no exact-current configured Oracle, Luna, Visual Likert or full-judge timing result exists; its 77 indexed artifacts matched their SHA256 values in probe-results.json (index SHA256 a31dac94df53b400d3a2db2a9069737beb026d2604066ea3774f1909852dfa92), but are scripted browser/product facts, not graded partial-app scores. No run-root runtime-evidence.json record exists for this row. Required empirical reward spread is therefore missing. Run the exact-current configured grader on several gate-passing partial implementations with different functional coverage and retain raw dimension and final scores, plus a gate-failing weak control, before clearing this row.
